# Cold Treatment and Carbon Uptake in R’s CO2 Dataset: Experimental Design, Measurement Provenance, and Physiological Limits

## At a glance

### What changed

- Chilled plants received 14 hours of daytime chilling at 7°C. [^S0aadb060bb3b] <!-- tempest-briefing-item: -->
- R's documentation describes the chilling treatment as occurring overnight. [^S7528fd2c1ece] <!-- tempest-briefing-item: -->
- Plants underwent 10 hours of nighttime recovery at 20°C before carbon-uptake response curves were generated. [^S0aadb060bb3b] <!-- tempest-briefing-item: -->
### Why it matters

- **Assessment:** Assess the decision implications of: Chilling had a larger observed effect on the photosynthetic CO₂ response curves of Mississippi plants than Québec plants. _(Evidence: `C_4aedd41cc0ecc97d`; confidence: medium.)_ <!-- tempest-briefing-item: -->
### Review today

- **Review:** Review before deciding: Each plant received the seven CO₂ levels in increasing, consecutive order. | Each control plant was randomly paired with a plant designated for chilling. | Three plants were measured for each population-by-chilling-treatment combination. _(Evidence: `C_2277c94eefb5869a`, `C_8b1a60b66d8f6f27`, `C_da954114dc68107b`.)_ <!-- tempest-briefing-item: -->

## Scientific review

Advisory review of 5 selected claim(s). Other claims were not reviewed. No issue found is not proof of correctness. Citation support and accepted knowledge are unchanged.

### C\_4afcf38e0b62d611

Claim: Table 2 expresses CO₂ uptake rates in micromoles per square metre per second\.

Review outcome: **No issue found**.

Adjudication: The reviewer found no issue, and the captured paper excerpt supports that assessment: the caption for the uptake table explicitly specifies micromoles per square metre per second\. The cited quotation directly addresses the reported units and identifies no concrete scientific defect\. This verdict concerns unit reporting only, not the validity of the measurements\.
Evidence (S0aadb060bb3b): “CO, uptake rate values \(in micromoles per square metre per second\) and associated ranks to test for the effects of \(A\) population \(P\) and treatment \(7\) and \(B\) the pop\- ulation \* treatment interaction \(PT,\) in the nonparametnc split\-plot analysis\. Pairing was done according to Table 1\.” Source: <https://biology.mcgill.ca/faculty/potvin/articles/PotvinLech_90.pdf>
Evidence search: not\_requested.
Review identity: `sha256:3e0aabc78447c7331bb9bcf4d41c4e80e6acf549e2f45af81ab4e66008733af6`.
